title: Java Testing
intro: Java testing interview questions cover the full testing pyramid — unit testing with JUnit 5 (lifecycle, parameterized tests, extensions), mocking with Mockito (verify, argument matchers, when not to mock), Spring Boot test slices, integration testing with Testcontainers, contract testing (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract), TDD discipline, performance testing, chaos testing, and the trade-offs between mocks vs real dependencies. This page covers JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers and the testing-strategy questions that come up at every level.
